description: The chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The vertical axis represents the language families, listed in descending order of the number of tasks, with labels including IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis is labeled "# tasks" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a colored bar, with the height corresponding to the number of tasks; the bars are colored in distinct hues, including light blue, blue, green, dark green, red, orange, yellow, gray, purple, and black. The bar heights vary significantly, with IE-Slavic having approximately 78 tasks, IE-Romance around 48, and Basque around 3, with the bars generally decreasing in height from top to bottom. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. Overall, the chart provides a clear visual representation of the number of tasks associated with each language family.
